headline: Hands-On AI Builder | Product & Program Leadership
summary: I build useful AI systems, backed by 16+ years delivering customer-focused software through program ownership, agile coaching, and hands-on building. AI lets me take more of the work directly from prototype to working system. I bring product judgment, measurable goals, evaluation, and handoff discipline to the things I build.
